name: Wacom Cintiq 16 AC Adapter (ACK43914Z)

The replacement Wacom 36 W Power Adaptor easily connects to your device and to a power cable of your choice. This power adaptor is specifically made for Wacom Cintiq 16 (DTK1660KOB).
